Work directly with our founder to turn product launches, founder stories and ambitious ideas into videos that earn attention, make people understand, and move them to act. Meet the founder: Watch this 60-second video About Us Base360.ai is building the AI operating system for short-term rental companies. Our platform grew out of the technology behind The Flex. We’re bringing that technology to other property managers, helping them launch, operate and scale their businesses on AI autopilot. We’re looking for a Video Content Editor who can make a complex product easy to understand and find compelling stories in the people building it. The role You’ll turn raw footage, product recordings and early ideas into launch films, founder content, social videos and ads. Your involvement starts before the first cut. You’ll help shape concepts, identify the strongest angle, suggest hooks and decide how each story should unfold. Then you’ll own the edit through to delivery. Some days, you’ll turn a long founder interview into a sharp, memorable story. On others, you’ll make a product feature instantly understandable or test different openings for an ad. Success means creating videos that hold attention, communicate clearly and get the right people interested in Base360. What you’ll do Create product launches and brand films. Combine storytelling, product demonstrations and motion graphics to show what Base360 makes possible. Turn founder footage into compelling stories. Find the strongest moments in interviews, conversations and behind-the-scenes recordings. Produce content for social platforms. Edit Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and LinkedIn videos with openings, pacing and formats suited to each channel. Develop and test ad creative. Explore different hooks, messages and calls to action, then use performance insights to improve the next version. Own post-production. Handle footage selection, editing, colour grading, sound design, music, captions and final exports. Help define our visual identity. Build a consistent approach to typography, motion, sound and composition across our videos. Use AI to expand what you can create. Generate supporting visuals, voiceovers and other assets where they strengthen the work or speed up production. What you’ll bring A portfolio that shows your judgement. We want to see clear storytelling, deliberate pacing, strong visual choices and attention to detail. Strong editing and motion skills. You’re proficient in Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, with experience in After Effects or an equivalent motion design tool. An instinct for the opening. You know how to create interest in the first few seconds and sustain it through the rest of the video. The ability to simplify. You can find the central idea in a long recording or complex product demonstration and build a clear story around it. An ear for sound. You understand how music, silence, dialogue and sound effects influence the way a video feels. Comfort with AI creative tools. You can incorporate tools such as Runway, Kling, Sora or ElevenLabs into your workflow when useful. Experience with SaaS product videos, founder content, documentary storytelling or paid social ads is a plus. Why join Base360? Work directly with the founder. Help shape the stories behind the product and the business. Have meaningful creative ownership. Bring ideas, develop new formats and influence how Base360 looks and sounds. See your work make an impact. Your videos will support product launches, marketing campaigns and conversations with potential customers. Grow with the company. There’s an opportunity to take on broader creative leadership and help build a video team. Competitive salary and performance incentives. Remote work with an ambitious, entrepreneurial team. How we work We move quickly, communicate directly and take responsibility for what we deliver. You’ll be expected to bring ideas, make creative decisions, meet deadlines and improve your work through feedback. Priorities can change, and experimentation is part of the job. This role suits someone who enjoys taking initiative, cares about both the craft and the outcome, and wants to keep raising the quality of their work.
